purpose: Reviewable source for the M515 requirement-coverage correction. It separates, for each touched requirement, the contour M515 actually delivered (a bound-and-recomputed evidence pointer linkage, or a guard touch, or a terminal-gate advance) from the substantive clause that remains open. The driving operator applies the recorded_coverage_statement text to the requirement store and the S06 requirements sections; this block itself changes no requirement status and no measured artifact.

evidence_source.recomputation_rule: Every revision_sha256 below is recomputed from committed bytes by crates/da-cli/tests/requirement_evidence_linkage_test.rs and crates/da-cli/tests/native_acceptance_package_test.rs; a stale pin fails that test. Linkage proves the pointer resolves to committed bytes, not that the requirement is satisfied.

measured_fact.rule: a candidate whose series fingerprint equals the frozen reference series is the same series; a same-series candidate can evidence conservation, not independent non-inferiority

c1_series_identity_residual.reviewer_disagreement: The milestone roadmap assessment of 2026-10-04 records Reviewer A NEEDS-ATTENTION semantics on this reading: with candidate_fingerprint equal to reference_fingerprint, the three frozen thresholds resolve met on conservation of the frozen reference series, not on independent non-inferiority, so the same-series verdict can be read as a residual gap. Decision D536 records the verdict as deliberate derived package data (data/parse/absorption_progress.schema.yaml declares comparability.same_series_required: true) and machine-checkable; D534 records that S04 never claimed the candidate is independent. The residual stays disclosed and unresolved.
